# SeqPlots example data (ce10 chrI 100 kb)

Copied from https://github.com/Przemol/seqplots/tree/master/inst/extdata

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `GSM1208360_chrI_100Kb_q5_sample.bw` | H3K4me3 ChIP-seq BigWig (`chrI`, 100 kb) |
| `GSM1208361_chrI_100Kb_PeakCalls.bed` | Peak calls (16 intervals) |
| `Transcripts_ce10_chrI_100Kb.bed` | Transcript models (BED12, 25 rows) |

These are the files used in SeqPlots `plotAverage` / `plotHeatmap` documentation examples (`getPlotSetArray(bw1, c(bed1, bed2), 'ce10')`).
